combination.construction:
'MM1-v3.2 + all three' (by construction, no refit; desk/compose_e222 below): each candidate is MM1-v3.2 exactly outside its
domain (posimb: subset masks of rgm136 gemmL; L3S: the full mask, gemmL-family loops; AF4: gemmLnc tokens), so per point at most posimb, or
L3S, or AF4, or L3S with AF4 (a full-mask gemmLnc point) acts. Where L3S and AF4 both act the composition is exact because they touch disjoint
parts of MM1-v3.2: L3S moves A's lines between the L3 and DRAM classes (Q' = Q + lam dA outer((0, 1, -1), B's marginal)), which leaves A's L2
share and B's marginal - the only map figures AF4's features read - unchanged, and F3's coefficient F3 x t_op is independent of the op time;
so B'' = B_L3S - F3 t + dW t on L3S's op time. compose() checks every one of these at every point and refuses (exit 5) otherwise.
